Follow existing conventions; check sibling files when creating/editing files. MUST activate the relevant skill whenever you work in that domain—don't wait until you're stuck.

`wayfinder-development` activates whenever referencing backend routes in frontend components, including `@/actions`, `@/routes`, Laravel routes from TypeScript, or Wayfinder route functions. `pest-testing` activates when writing/debugging tests, assertions, datasets, mocks, browser/Livewire tests, or when the user mentions test, spec, TDD, expects, assertion, coverage, or verification.

Do not create verification scripts or tinker when tests cover that functionality and prove they work. Stick to existing directory structure; don't create new base folders without approval. Do not change the application's dependencies without approval. You must only create documentation files if explicitly requested by the user.

Use Laravel Boost MCP tools. Use `list-artisan-commands` before Artisan commands when checking parameters. Use `get-absolute-url` for every project URL. Use `tinker` for PHP/Eloquent debugging; `database-query` for read-only database access; `database-schema` before migrations/models; `browser-logs` for recent browser logs only; `search-docs` before version-specific code changes, using multiple broad simple queries and package arrays when known. Do not add package names to search queries.

Always use curly braces for control structures. Use PHP 8 constructor property promotion. Do not allow empty `__construct()` methods with zero parameters unless the constructor is private. Always use explicit return type declarations and appropriate parameter type hints. Prefer PHPDoc blocks. Never use comm
